LESSON: READING FOR UNDERSTANDING

Grade: Grade 7
Subject: MANDARIN
Strand: Reading 2.1 Reading Aloud (2 lessons) • Pronunciation (tones) By the end of the 
Topic 2.1: Reading for Understanding
Suggested lessons in curriculum: 2

SECTION 1: INTRODUCTION

This lesson covers Reading for Understanding, part of Reading 2.1 Reading Aloud (2 lessons) • Pronunciation (tones) By the end of the  in Grade 7 MANDARIN.

Key inquiry question: How can understanding be enhanced in reading texts?

You will study the official KICD learning outcomes, classroom activities, values, and competencies for this topic. Use Kenyan examples from your county, school, and community throughout.

SECTION 2: LEARNING OUTCOMES

By the end of this topic, you should be able to:

Refer to the KICD curriculum reference at the end of this lesson for the full list of outcomes.

SECTION 3: KEY CONCEPTS AND EXPLANATION

A. Suggested learning experiences (from KICD)

1. complete the blanks with the appropriate words/phrases related to titles of nuclear family members and professions,

2. read a text on introductions of nuclear family members and their professions and find unfamiliar words,

3. use a dictionary/other resources to find the meaning of the unfamiliar words and create a word wall collaboratively,

4. read a dialogue and answer the corresponding questions,

5. take turns to read short texts related to nuclear family members and assign an appropriate title for each of them,

6. establish a reading corner to foster a reading culture in the classroom with peers.

SECTION 4: LEARNING ACTIVITIES

A. At school

1. complete the blanks with the appropriate words/phrases related to titles of nuclear family members and professions,
2. read a text on introductions of nuclear family members and their professions and find unfamiliar words,
3. use a dictionary/other resources to find the meaning of the unfamiliar words and create a word wall collaboratively,
4. read a dialogue and answer the corresponding questions,
5. take turns to read short texts related to nuclear family members and assign an appropriate title for each of them,
6. establish a reading corner to foster a reading culture in the classroom with peers.

B. At home with your parent or guardian

1. Read this lesson on Reading for Understanding together.
2. Discuss the key inquiry question and give examples from your area.
3. Write five sentences summarising what you learned.
4. Prepare for the revision quiz at the end of this topic.

SECTION 5: CORE COMPETENCIES, VALUES, AND PCIs

Core Competencies to be developed:
• Learning to Learn: the learner is motivated to learn continuously when they establish a reading corner to promote a positive

reading culture.

• Creativity and Imagination: the learner undertakes group activities that inspire creative thinking as they create a word wall

from the unfamiliar words identified.

Values:
Unity: the learner displays team spirit as they take turns to assign appropriate titles to texts.

Pertinent and Contemporary Issues:
(PCIs):

Self-esteem is promoted as the learner develops confidence in their reading abilities.

Link to Other Learning Areas:

Learning is linked to Creative Arts and Sports on the concept of creatively expressing one’s ideas.
